scope: Native Fountain browser editor in the actual GitLab application; partial toolbar/providers, not full product acceptance
checks: Normal web sign-in and authenticated API version match the image/source pin
Real private project, PNG upload and issue created through authenticated GitLab HTTP APIs
Real browser clipboard Markdown renders through the actual GitLab service, inserts with reference/marks, and supports one-step undo/redo
An actual unsupported GitLab-rendered footnote leaves the document untouched, exposes exact retained source and recovers through a later supported paste
Real picker upload yields a decoded image; invalid size retains its property draft; description/title/width changes, undo/redo and actual clipboard copy preserve the canonical source
Actual source-mode editing adds an image link; real GitLab rendering reopens the linked image with its title and width intact
A real empty picker selection leaves the media unchanged; an actual WAV upload cannot replace a linked image, exposes retained upload recovery without a misleading retry, and is removable
Real offline replacement upload retains its original target; after typing elsewhere, Retry uploads and replaces that same media instead of inserting at the new cursor
Delete and actual typing stay in the original paragraph; undo restores the image; replacement picker uploads a new file; real offline URL failure retains the draft and online retry applies it

Actual WAV/VP8 files upload and play through native controls using user clicks; separate selection buttons expose properties without intercepting playback; descriptions, source-only titles and video width remain editable
Actual native toolbar file chooser uploads an image and text file through authenticated GitLab HTTP; canonical native insertion and one-step image undo/redo pass
Actual browser image clipboard and native paste upload through GitLab instead of embedding binary data in document JSON
A real over-limit file blocks Save without changing the server original; explicit removal immediately saves the intact draft and uploads without generated empty formatting carriers
Native Fountain toolbar formats actual browser selection; undo and redo update both document and view
Rebuilt real host hands current rich content to source mode and reopens it without a stale cached value
Actual UI Save retains native media URLs, descriptions, titles and dimensions; the GitLab reader decodes the saved image/audio/video files
Saved native upload Markdown survives reader rendering; the actual text attachment returns its original bytes through GitLab
Native rich typing and UI save persisted the added paragraph and retained the seeded content in the server record
An actual empty comment paints its placeholder, hides it on focus/typing and restores empty state after real comment persistence
An initially empty native Fountain composer creates a real GitLab discussion comment and clears after successful persistence
Actual unsupported saved Markdown refuses editing through Retry; explicit recovery enables a local draft, cancelled without changing the server original
Unauthenticated upload into the private real project is refused by GitLab
Private issue is unavailable to an unauthenticated browser context
Exact saved server source, authenticated session and uploaded image survive an actual application-container restart
secrets: Password/session used in memory only; no traces or storage-state files

nativeRuntime.scope: Native Fountain/GitLab integration runtime; not a deployed or complete GitLab replacement
